name: InitPlayers
comment: New game: initial values for all players (humans: title 0, 1000 Taler, 10000 ha, 1000 people; cheat names Alchimisten/Berserker with census editor: Koenig + 999000 Taler; computers: random spell, optional strong start), then shuffles the human order. See docs/rules/land-market.md

name: UpdateMarketPrices
comment: Yearly prices of land (per 10 Hf), salt, beer, wine, weapons for one player

name: UpdateGrainPrice
comment: grain_price = round((RandomReal*20+20) * (6 - harvest_quality) / 3 + 30)

name: UnclaimedLand
comment: max(0, num_players*100000 - total land of all players)

name: FreeBuildingLand
comment: (land - land_used) - 1000 * max(count of any building type)

name: Prokurist
comment: Auto-sell: for each good with prokurist_on and price >= minimum, sell the whole stock

name: ProduceGoods
comment: Yearly salt (north) or wine (south) by country, beer from grain if brew_beer, weapons from smithies; capped by warehouse space; returns warehouses full

name: SmithyOutput
comment: min(population/2000, land/20000)

name: WarehouseFreeSpace
comment: warehouses*1000 - (salt + beer + wine + weapons)

name: BuildingsLostForLand
comment: After selling land: buildings that no longer fit (dialog VERLUSTDLG)

name: LandDlg_Trade
comment: land -= amount; taler += amount * land_price / 10; total_land_trade += same

name: TradeCaravan
comment: Random caravan offering goods (SALZ/BIER/WEIN/WAFFENKARAWANEDLG); chance 1/(20 - fame/10) per turn when goods trade is enabled

name: AskWarehousesFull
comment: LAGERVOLLDLG: warehouses full, choose what to do

name: PlaySound
comment: Sound effect (segment 15, sndPlaySound of WAVEDATA); args (mode, sound id)

name: CountryProducesWine
comment: byte per country 0..9: 1 = salt (north), 3 = wine (south)

name: CountryNames
comment: char[25] x 20: 10 country names, then 10 adjectives (INI-renamable)

name: TitleNamesMale
comment: char[25] x 11: Herr .. Kaiser

name: TitleNamesFemale
comment: char[25] x 11: Frau .. Kaiserin

name: SpellNames
comment: char[25] x 13: Nichts, Ambassador .. Terror

name: PlayerAndUnitNames
comment: char[25] x 46: 10 computer player names, then unit types (index - 10 = unit type)

name: RankNames
comment: char[25] x 11: Fuchs, Offizier, Haudegen, Elite, then hero ranks Lehrling .. Halbgott

name: AbilityNames
comment: char[25] x 38: special abilities, 1-based

name: BuildingPrices
comment: longint x 9: market 1000, mill 2000, palace part 5000, cathedral part 9000, granary 2500, warehouse 4000, university part 4000, tavern 2000, smithy 2500
